items.q: What types of dressers do you remove?
a: We remove all types, including wooden, metal, mirrored, antique, horizontal, vertical, and lingerie dressers, as well as chests of drawers.

items.q: Do I need to empty my dresser before pickup?
a: Yes, please empty all drawers before removal to ensure safe and efficient transport.

items.q: Can you remove heavy or oversized dressers?
a: Absolutely! Our team is equipped to handle heavy, bulky, and oversized dressers safely.
